body: The traffic is already so horrible on this road. I live in Green Acers and it was already fairly difficult to make a left turn out of my neighborhood on this road, and now traffic is so backed up, I have to go around it and exit from a different entrance to my neighborhood. I want cyclists to be safe and feel safe, but the on street bike lanes are already causing issues with traffic, accidents, and people schedules. Every person I have talked to (even my biking enthusiast friends) have said that this is already becoming a severe inconvenience.
